supply_sweep.title: Supply Sweep
supply_sweep.description: Search one of four Tilburg activity areas for six supplies; some routes include light rival resistance.

hold_relay.title: Hold the Relay
hold_relay.description: Protect a relay at one of four district sites through three short, location-specific rival waves.

courier_chaos.title: Courier Chaos
courier_chaos.description: Collect packages from one of four dispatch points and choose among that route's active city drop zones.

chaos_call.title: Call the Heat
chaos_call.description: Willingly trigger a short justice response from one of four city districts.
